summary: Sampling as ComfyUI's Anima template does: Euler, 30 steps, CFG 4, with its negative prompt.

samples.negative: worst quality, low quality, score_1, score_2, score_3, blurry, jpeg artifacts, sepia

notes: Keep a negative prompt: at CFG 4 an empty one draws streaks of noise, before any training (the base model in plain ComfyUI does the same).
An anime model: prompts in its own style ("1girl, solo, long silver hair, ...") come out cleanest; photo prompts drift.
A trigger that's a real word is read as one ("aurora" draws the northern lights): a made-up word trains cleaner.
Shift 3 is ComfyUI's default for Anima already.
